title: add downgrade guard, version pinning, backup/restore and transactional schema migrations for private-installer
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds transactional schema migration support and a downgrade guard for the private installer; introduces version pinning for components and robust backup/restore hooks for safe upgrades. Operators should follow the new upgrade checklist in docs/private-installer/upgrade.md.
description: Motivation and summary: Private deployments need safe, auditable upgrade and rollback paths. This PR implements a set of coordinated changes for the private-installer to make upgrades safer: 1) a downgrade guard that prevents operators from accidentally installing a cluster with older schema/component versions; 2) version pinning for critical components in the Helm charts and the installer manifest; 3) transactional schema migrations (Postgres) to ensure forward and backward compatibility during rolling upgrades; 4) explicit backup and restore hooks (scripts and operator docs) that are invoked as part of the installer upgrade path. This PR is driven by ENG-4821 and incidents SUP-1145 where a failed upgrade left clusters in mixed-schema state. Checklist: - [x] Add downgrade guard check to installer pre-upgrade validation - [x] Implement version pin manifest and Helm value overrides - [x] Add transactional migration SQL and migration guard in the migration runner - [x] Add backup/restore scripts and automated smoke verification post-restore - [x] Update private-installer docs and add operator checklist - [x] Add unit + integration tests for migration runner and backup/restore flow Non-goals: this PR does not rework the operator reconciliation loop or change runtime behaviour of serving components. Technical details: - Downgrade guard: the installer now records the current "schema_version" and "component_versions" in the cluster metadata store during upgrade. The pre-upgrade validation compares desired versions with recorded values and stops the upgrade if a downgrade is detected unless explicitly overridden with --force-downgrade. - Version pinning: Helm charts now accept explicit image:tag and chartVersion pins via the top-level values.yaml. The private-installer manifest supports a new component_pins block. - Transactional schema migrations: migrations are now wrapped in a small transaction manager which runs each migration inside a transaction when supported by the database engine and writes a migration lock record; rollbacks attempt to reverse the steps where a down migration is provided. - Backup/restore: the installer adds pre-upgrade hooks that invoke backups (logical pg_dump + s3 upload or local tar) and post-upgrade verification that the service is responsive. The backup/restore script supports explicit dry-run and restore-from-s3 modes. Testing and safety: added integration scenarios in perf-canary/tests/private-installer that run upgrade -> migrate -> verify -> rollback using ephemeral clusters. Also added unit tests for the migration-runner. Upgrade path and rollback: see docs/private-installer/upgrade.md (updated) for step-by-step. Migration strategy: migrations are labeled with a transactional flag and include idempotency checks. Rollback guard: if restore is required the installer will attempt an automated restore from the most recent backup and abort further changes. Rollout notes: operators should ensure they have a recent backup before upgrading and test the restore path in a staging environment. Linked work: ENG-4821, ENG-4902, incident SUP-1145.
commits_summary: Initial downgrade-guard scaffold; add version pinning to Helm charts; implement migration runner and transactional SQL; add backup/restore scripts and test harness; docs and upgrade checklist; address reviewer feedback (fix lock handling, add retry/backoff).
review_conversation:
Alex Kim: Left a request for changes around lock handling in migration_runner — we need exponential backoff on lock acquisition.
Priya Nair (author): Addressed; added backoff and jitter with a 5s base and updated tests.
Ravi Patel: Asked for clarity in the upgrade.md steps about forced downgrades and RBAC implications.
Priya Nair: Expanded docs and added a warning block; added an explicit --force-downgrade flag and an operator acknowledgement step.
Jasmine Li: Ran the integration test locally and reported a flaky failure on restore when S3 creds expired; suggested retry and clearer error messaging.
Priya Nair: Added retries and clearer error messages and a new integration test that simulates transient S3 failures.
Alex Kim: Approved after fixes. Ravi Patel: Approved. Jasmine Li: Approved with comment "consider telemetry event for failed restores" — added a TODO and linked ENG-4902.
notes_for_operators: Before upgrading: take a full backup (private-installer/scripts/backup-restore.sh --backup), verify backup integrity (check uploaded artifact in S3/local store), and run upgrade in staging. The installer will prevent downgrades by default; pass --force-downgrade to override after manual verification. To rollback: run private-installer/scripts/backup-restore.sh --restore --from-s3 <url> and follow docs/private-installer/upgrade.md step 6. Contact Platform SRE if migrations fail — migration logs are at /var/log/redwood/migrations and the installer writes telemetry with migration result events.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for migration runner and downgrade guard; added an integration scenario in perf-canary that validates upgrade -> migration -> smoke -> rollback. Tests simulate transient S3 failures to verify retry logic. Manual verification performed on staging cluster staging-us-west-2-priv-01.
post_merge_followups: (1) Add telemetry event for failed restores (ENG-4902) (2) Add operator UI in console to surface last backup snapshot (3) Add automated periodic backup verification job in dedicated clusters
changelog_entry: Private-installer: transactional schema migrations, downgrade guard + version pinning, backup/restore hooks and upgrade checklist (operators must read docs/private-installer/upgrade.md)
hotfix_reference: Related to incident SUP-1145 where upgrade left cluster with mixed schemas; this PR provides the guardrails to prevent recurrence.
